_comment: Product parts built from CAD (Day 6/7). make_part_variants.ps1 writes usd/<part>_<variant>.usda (final shape) and, for processed parts, usd/<part>_<variant>_raw.usda (before processing), as reference + override layers on the converted USD (never edited). Paths relative to the converted asset's default prim; paint_prims '*' = every mesh. Paint colours are simulation choices. Optional per part: process (station + cycle seconds, compressed time), spawn_interval_s, camera (inspection camera height above the belt and focal length).

crown._comment: Dental milling line (Day 7): blank -> mill -> crown. Our own CadQuery models (scripts/make_dental_parts.ps1), real size. Zirconia ivory vs wrong material (pink PMMA); shape defect = milling left a corner of blank material (tool breakage). cycle_s is compressed (a real crown takes 10+ minutes).
